title: Higgs Boson Theory
definition: The Higgs Boson Theory explains the existence of the Higgs field, an invisible energy field permeating the universe that interacts with fundamental particles to impart mass through the Brout-Englert-Higgs mechanism.
importanceInUpsc: Tested in Science and Technology (GS-3) under fundamental physics, atomic research, global scientific collaborations (CERN, Large Hadron Collider), and India's strategic contributions to frontier mega-science projects.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Higgs Boson Theory.
